title: Bar indicator / Live feedback

location.series: DB new design / original GIF demonstrations

slide_intent: Make a changing position visible because users need to track the relationship between a marker and a value.
strategic_value: Animating Schwelle-derived bars can connect functional feedback to DB’s broader visual system.
demonstration: A white downward triangle travels above a long red bar sequence; a cluster of thicker bars follows it across the dark field.
practical_value: Assess whether the moving marker and local bar emphasis remain easy to follow at the intended UI size.

content_islands.name: Indicator track
content_islands.spec: Align the triangular marker above the bars and keep both changes coordinated.

reference_purposes.Application: The demonstration uses a marker and changing bar weights to show live feedback.
